data.one_liner: A grid layout system for Flutter inspired by CSS Grid Layout.
data.what_it_does: It provides a powerful grid layout system optimized for complex user interface designs. It supports fixed, flexible, and content-sized tracks, precise item positioning, overlapping items, and named grid areas.
use_when: You need complex 2D layouts with fixed, flexible, or content-sized rows and columns.
You want to use named grid areas for descriptive layout design similar to CSS Grid.
avoid_when: You need features not yet supported, such as negative row/column starts/ends or minmax() track sizing.
You require explicit automatic addition of rows and columns to accommodate out-of-bound items.
strengths: Precise control over item placement, spanning, and overlapping.
Named grid areas for readable layouts.
Helpful extension methods for concise track sizing and widget placement.
weaknesses: Does not support negative row or column indices.
Throws an error if items are placed outside the explicitly defined grid.

alternatives.name: flutter_staggered_grid_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose it if you specifically need staggered or heterogeneous grid layouts with varying item sizes.

data.minimal_example:
LayoutGrid(
  columnSizes: [152.px, 1.fr, 152.px],
  rowSizes: [112.px, auto, 1.fr, 64.px],
  children: [
    Header().inGridArea('header'),
    Navigation().inGridArea('nav'),
  ],
)
